answer: Each identity must fund its own vault with 8 coins and then climb a summit of 25 sequential micro-jobs for 25 different established requesters, each verified by receipt, a sable marker flagging any shared requester across identities. One operator with 1,000 Sybils needs 25,000 distinct verified jobs, 8,000 coins locked in separate vaults, and at least 25 days, because jobs for one identity are capped at 1 per day.
